## Description

About Awan Ledger

Awan Ledger runs the payout and reconciliation platform behind 1,200 Malaysian online sellers and three e-wallets. Reconciliation runs as a nightly batch today; this year it moves to near-real-time.

What you will do

- Own the payouts service in Go end to end: reliability, idempotent retries and the on-call rotation.

- Cut reconciliation lag by moving the nightly batch to near-real-time processing on PostgreSQL and SQS.

- Set SLOs and alerting for the merchant-facing payout APIs.

Requirements

- 3+ years of backend engineering experience.

- Go in production and solid PostgreSQL.

- AWS (SQS, RDS) and Docker.

- Payments experience is an advantage.

Work arrangement

- Hybrid, 2 days a week in the Mid Valley office.
